scope: One fixed-profile design check, not a fossil observation model or parameter ensemble
intervention: Whole finite-capacity mechanism versus uncapped growth
support: All common native finite endpoint cells; reject unequal masks, infinities or coordinates
spatial_weights: cos(latitude at centre of the native 0.5 degree latitude bin), normalized across supported cells
primary_statistic: Squared Hellinger distance between normalized weighted local-richness profiles
observer: Multinomial cell-incidence counts conditional on a fixed detected total; independent draws with replacement
gate: If affinity-based upper power bound is below target, this observer fails at this budget; otherwise inconclusive
